Action: Add 400 ladders to the order. Reduce total by 30 for returned stock.

Garden studio is being repainted (morning noise expected) and is too cold in the morning. Coffee machine in loading bay is working again.

Queries: Suri asked if the print room is free in the evening. Vik asked whether the east wing is free in the evening. Finn asked whether the garden studio is free in the afternoon.
